name: Electric submersible pumps
principle: A downhole multistage centrifugal pump driven by a submersible motor on a cable lifts 16 to 4,770 m³/d (100 to 30,000 bbl/d). SLB reports an installed base of 150,000 to 200,000 wells and notes ESPs are usually uneconomic below about 25 m³/d.

process_steps.name: Surface drive sends power down the cable
Pump lifts fluid; gas separator removes free gas

source.note: SLB Oilfield Review, Defining series: electrical submersible pumps
SLB Oilfield Review, Defining series: electrical submersible pumps
Wikipedia, Artificial lift, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

performance.basis: Average ESP lifespan of 1,058 days in the offshore field studied, with half of all ESPs below 1,000 days.

source.note: SPE Journal (2026), ESP lifespan prediction, read 2026-11-17

advantages: VSD gives flexibility and longer run life
limitations: Gas, sand and viscous fluids shorten run life
